title: order - Flexbox & Grid - Tailwind CSS
content_text:
FLEXBOX & GRID order Utilities for controlling the order of flex and grid items. Class Styles order- order: ; -order- order: calc( * -1); order-first order: -9999; order-last order: 9999; order-() order: var(); order-[] order: ; EXAMPLES Explicitly setting a sort order Use order- utilities like order-1 and order-3 to render flex and grid items in a different order than they appear in the document: 01 02 03
01
02
03
Ordering items first or last Use the order-first and order-last utilities to render flex and grid items first or last: 01 02 03
01
02
03

This is just a shorthand for order-[var()] that adds the var() function for you automatically. Responsive design Prefix an order utility with a breakpoint variant like md: to only apply the utility at medium screen sizes and above:
